points.description: States that when a multi-dimensional array is passed as a function argument, all dimensions except the first must be specified (equivalently: the first dimension may be omitted, while every remaining dimension must be given).
points.partial_credit: Award part marks for an answer that gives only one side of the rule: either that all dimensions must be specified, or that the first dimension may be omitted, without stating the full exception.

levels.says: Says all dimensions must be specified, but does not note that the first dimension is the exception.
Says the first dimension need not be specified, but does not state that all the other dimensions must be specified.

rubric.notes: Full marks require saying that every dimension except the first must be specified when passing a multi-dimensional array to a function. Part marks are for answers that state only that all dimensions are needed, or only that the first dimension can be omitted, without the complete rule. Answers saying only the first dimension must be specified, or that no dimensions are needed, earn no marks.
